metadata.title: Splitting and Mixed Deformations of Toric Generalized Kähler Potentials
metadata.abstract: We study splitting phenomena for extremal toric generalized Kähler structures on products of compact toric manifolds. We prove that every extremal symplectic potential splits when the skew-symmetric parameter $B$ is block diagonal, without any restriction on $A$. We also construct two types of non-splitting examples on $\mathbb{CP}^1\times\mathbb{CP}^1$: an explicit constant-generalized-scalar-curvature structure with a splitting potential but a non-product generalized Kähler structure, and a deformation family of constant-generalized-scalar-curvature structures with genuinely non-splitting potentials.
